name: Job Monetizer
author: arthalink

sections.description:
Turn your WordPress site into a job board that pays you — no manual work required.

Job Monetizer is a free WordPress plugin powered by the Artha.Link network. Display targeted job listings on your website using shortcodes, Gutenberg blocks, or widgets, and earn revenue from valid clicks (RPC) and job applications (RPA). Jobs are fetched automatically, so listings are always fresh and relevant. Currently supports jobs in the United States, India, the United Kingdom, and Germany.

How it works:

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Add the shortcode [jobmo_feed] to any page or post, or use the Gutenberg blocks.
  3. Jobs are automatically displayed from Artha.Link.
  4. Earn revenue from valid clicks and applications.

Key Features:

  • Display dynamic job listings using shortcodes or Gutenberg blocks.
  • Earn revenue from validated user interactions (clicks and applications).
  • Automatic job updates via API (no manual posting required).
  • Smart filtering by location, job type, work mode, salary, and company.
  • Niche keyword targeting for relevant job results.
  • Works with any WordPress theme.

Ideal For:

  • Bloggers and content creators
  • Niche website owners
  • Career and education platforms
  • Job portals and listing websites

External Services

This plugin relies on the Artha.Link API as its core job data provider. All job listings, job details, search filters, and job board functionality are powered by this service.

Artha.Link Job API

What it does: Provides job listing data, job detail pages, search/filter options, and similar job recommendations that power the plugin’s job board functionality.

When data is sent:

  • When the job feed shortcode or block is loaded, the plugin sends a request to retrieve job listings. Search keywords, niche keywords, location, and pagination parameters are sent.
  • When a visitor views a job detail page, the plugin requests the full job details for that specific job. The job slug is sent.
  • When the filter panel is loaded, the plugin requests available filter options (job type, location, and other filter data).
  • When similar jobs are displayed, the plugin requests related job listings. The current job slug is sent.

Revenue attribution (apply-click redirect):

  • When a visitor clicks an “Apply” button on a job listing, they are redirected to the job application page via a tracking URL. The URL includes query parameters for revenue attribution: a static client ID, the site domain name, and a source identifier. No separate API call is made — the redirect URL is built client-side from the job data. This is required for the plugin to function as a monetization tool — without it, clicks cannot be credited to your site.

Service provider: Artha Link

  • Service URL: https://artha.link
  • Terms of Service: https://artha.link/terms-and-conditions/
  • Privacy Policy: https://artha.link/privacy-policy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the job-monetizer folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin via the WordPress admin.
  3. Go to Job Monetizer settings to configure your preferences.
  4. Add the shortcode [jobmo_feed] to any page or post, or use the Gutenberg blocks.
sections.faq:
What is Job Monetizer and how can I earn with it?

Job Monetizer is a free plugin that lets you display job listings on your site using a shortcode. Jobs are fetched from the Artha.Link network, and you earn revenue from valid clicks (RPC) and applications (RPA). Only genuine interactions are counted.

How does the plugin work?

After activation, the plugin automatically fetches job listings based on niche keywords, location, and job type. These jobs are displayed on your site, and earnings are generated when users interact with them.

Which countries does Job Monetizer support?

Job Monetizer currently supports job listings in the United States, India, the United Kingdom, and Germany. Set the country code in your settings or shortcode attributes (US, IN, GB, DE) to fetch location-specific jobs. Support for additional countries is being expanded through the Artha.Link network.

Why are some clicks not counted in earnings?

Only verified interactions are eligible for earnings. Invalid clicks may be filtered due to duplicate activity, bot traffic, mismatched location, expired listings, or fraud detection checks.

Do I need a job board website to use this plugin?

No. You can use it on blogs, niche sites, or any WordPress website. Just place the shortcode and start displaying jobs.

Are job listings updated automatically?

Yes. Jobs are fetched live via API on each page load, ensuring listings are always current.

Is Job Monetizer free?

Yes, the plugin is completely free to use with no setup or subscription costs.

What data is sent to external services?

The plugin sends job search parameters (keywords, niche keywords, location) to the Artha.Link API to fetch listings. When a visitor clicks “Apply”, they are redirected via a tracking URL that includes the site domain for revenue attribution. See the External Services section for full details.
